q2_gaps: "When P, Q" with a STATIVE, kind-level trigger clause ("when nightmoths are scarce"): the whenever machinery presumes an eventive trigger with its own witness to match, Skolemize over and `During`-link the response to, so a `KindProperty` condition leaves no trigger variable and the mandated `During` atom cannot be emitted — the temporal/occasion tie between condition and response is lost.
notes: Routing is well-motivated: the "when" restriction has no slot in a kind relation, so the distributing rule is forced exactly as an adjectivally-restricted kind subject forces it, and the condition sits in the premise so it is never asserted. `scarce` as `KindProperty`, the solid-spelling `nightmoth`→`moth` genus, "sometimes"→0.5 with its companion, and the bare-kind object filler all match the instruction set.
